request.text:
A: Such a mess on the bridge. Still, the road is open, and roads are so very good for business.
<long pause>
A: Feeding goblins from the town's stores. How generous. I do hope someone is keeping accounts.
<long pause>
B: Goblins at the gate and not one of them dead. The council is furious. I have never slept better.
